notes: PARTIAL SEGMENT — core scaffold only. The task brief for this run claimed a prior agent had already produced this file with all 543 MP-seat positions and asked me to adversarially verify it; no such file, scratch data, or git history existed anywhere in the repo before this turn (verified via ls/find/git log). I could not verify a nonexistent file, and building 543 individually-sourced MP records from scratch is a large dedicated research task (see other segments' scratch/ dirs for the scale that took), not something to improvise under a 'verifier' brief with an exhausted WebSearch budget (200/200 used this session) and a rate-limited (HTTP 429) Wikipedia parse API. So this file defines only the core Lok Sabha entities/positions (Speaker, Deputy Speaker, Leader of the House, Leader of the Opposition, Secretary-General, Secretariat) plus approximate party-wise strength. The 543 in-pos-mp-ls-<state>-<constituency-slug> positions, the panel of chairpersons, and by-election reconciliation since June 2024 are NOT included and need a dedicated follow-up build pass. Party-wise strength table below is medium confidence: WebFetch-summarized from the 18th Lok Sabha Wikipedia page on 2026-09-25 and sums to 543, but is likely the post-2024-election baseline, not fully reconciled against 2025-2026 by-elections/deaths/vacancies (two vacancies — Basirhat, Shillong — are separately confirmed and noted below).

entities.name: Parliament of India
entities.description: The bicameral national legislature of India, comprising the President, the Lok Sabha (House of the People) and the Rajya Sabha (Council of States). It makes Union and concurrent-list laws and holds the Union Council of Ministers accountable.

entities.name: Lok Sabha
entities.description: The directly-elected lower house of Parliament; 543 members elected from single-member territorial constituencies by universal adult suffrage. The Union Council of Ministers is collectively responsible to it. Current term: 18th Lok Sabha, constituted after the 2024 general election.
entities.notes: Party-strength figures are medium confidence — approximate 2024 post-election baseline extracted via WebFetch summary of the '18th Lok Sabha' Wikipedia page on 2026-09-25, not independently reconciled against every by-election, defection or merger since. Do not treat as authoritative without re-verification; a proper rebuild should pull the live composition table from sansad.in or the ECI. Two confirmed vacancies as of this page revision: Basirhat (TMC's Sk Nurul Islam died 2024-09-25) and Shillong (Ricky Andrew J. Syngkon died 2026-02-19).

entities.name: Lok Sabha Secretariat
entities.description: The permanent administrative and procedural secretariat that services the Lok Sabha, under the overall direction of the Speaker; headed by the Secretary-General.

holder.name: Om Birla
holder.notes: Re-elected Speaker for the 18th Lok Sabha; first held the office from 2019 in the 17th Lok Sabha.

positions.notes: Left unfilled for the entire 18th Lok Sabha as of 2026-09-25 (opposition has repeatedly raised this in Parliament); exact vacancy start date not independently confirmed this turn — treat as vacant since the House's constitution in June 2024 pending a source with an exact date.
